मौल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं)
 1. Radical, proceeding from a root or origin.
 2.
Of pure blood, descended from a respectable and primitive family
without any improper intermixture.
 E. मूल a root, and अण् aff.

मौलि mf. (-लिः-लिः or ली)
 1. A lock of hair on the crown of the head.
2. Hair ornamented and braided round the head.
 3. A diadem, a
tiara.
 4. The head.
 f. (-ली) The earth.
 E. मूल the root or base, aff.
इञ्; or मूल a name, and इञ् aff of descent; or मू to bind, लि
aff., and the radical vowel changed.
